  AGENDA
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  September 23, 2019

11:30 a.m. – Small Executive Conference, 9th Floor

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Persons wishing to address the Inglewood Claims Review Committee on any item on the agenda may do
so at this time.

  1. Approve the minutes of the September 16, 2019, meeting.

  2. Mariachi Divas – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for providing a 60
  minute music set for the City’s annual Hispanic Heritage Festival.

  3. A-Throne Co, Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for providing
  two hot and cold sinks for handwashing at the City’s annual Hispanic Heritage Festival.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Claims Review Committee on any matter connected with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

  Adjournment.

City of Inglewood

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  September 23, 2019

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Council Chambers, 9th floor at
11:34 a.m.:

  Members Present: Yvonne Horton, City Clerk Department
  Debbie Crenshaw, Treasure’s Department
  Ken Campos, City Attorney Department
  Maria Heaney, Finance Department

  Staff Present:  Teresa Estrada, Parks and Recreation

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
  Member Heaney reported no public comments.

  1. The minutes of September 16, 2019, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. Mariachi Divas – A motion was moved and seconded to approve the recommended
  payment for the musical performance at the Hispanic Heritage Festival of $1,500.00.
  Motion carried unanimously.

  3. A-Throne Co – A motion was moved and seconded to approve the recommended
  payment for the usage of the three sinks for handwashing at the Hispanic Heritage
  Festival in the amount of $1,305.00. Motion carried unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
  Member Heaney reported no public comments.

  There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 11:48 a.m.

Adjournment
